title: A Goofy Movie: Eye to Eye
description: A school-assembly stunt, a fishing trip, and a family move that brings down the house—five steps deep into the Goofs.
imageHint: Cartoon father and teenage son in a car on a road trip with camping gear and maps

questions.question: In 1995's A Goofy Movie, which teenage son is mortified that he inherited his dad's laugh?
questions.explanation: Jason Marsden took over Max's voice from the Goof Troop TV series. The whole road-trip idea came from Jeffrey Katzenberg planning a real car trip with his daughter.

questions.question: On the last day of school, Max hijacks the assembly dressed as what pop star, lip-syncing "Stand Out"?
questions.explanation: The stunt makes Max famous and lands him in Principal Mazur's office. Mazur, voiced by Wallace Shawn, warns Goofy his son is headed for the electric chair.

questions.question: Determined to end Max's Powerline phase, Goofy drags him on a father-son fishing trip to what spot in Idaho?
questions.explanation: Max secretly redraws the route on Goofy's map, heading for the Powerline concert in L.A. instead. Lester's Possum Park is just one of the stops they really do make.

questions.question: On the road to Lake Destiny, Goofy teaches Max the fishing move his own father taught him. What's it called?
questions.explanation: Max later uses it to save Goofy from going over a waterfall. Director Kevin Lima built the concert finale around it, adding, "I don't know if you've ever tried it, but it is quite difficult."

questions.question: Onstage at the Powerline concert, Goofy turns the Perfect Cast into a dance move during what song?
questions.explanation: Powerline's look was shaped by Prince, and his voice is R&B singer Tevin Campbell, once known as "Prince's protégé." Rosie Gaines, from Prince's own band, sings the high part.

easterEgg.title: Hidden voices
easterEgg.text: Bobby, Max's spray-cheese-loving sidekick, is an uncredited Pauly Shore. Bigfoot's growls are Frank Welker, and director Kevin Lima himself voices a walk-around mascot at Lester's Possum Park.
